messages.author: ff37ef06837e25ed
messages.subject: Plot mirror image of tree?
parts:
Hi, I have a very simple question. Is it possible to plot the tree as a mirror image, so that the labels appear on the left? Thanks!

Jess

messages.author: 65135aac151a06a7
messages.subject: Re: Plot mirror image of tree?
parts:
Hi Jess,

reverse_x_scale() will do that. The tip labels will need to be offset a bit (hjust) since the default is to be left-justified to the end of the branch.

library(ape)
library(ggtree)
#makes test tree
tree <- rtree(5)
ggtree(tree) + scale_x_reverse() + geom_tiplab(hjust=1,align=FALSE)
ggtree(tree) + scale_x_reverse() + geom_tiplab(hjust=1,align=TRUE)
